description: This source file defines the SecurePrefs class, which provides secure and regular shared preferences management for an Android application. It includes functionality for handling encrypted preferences, managing app-specific settings such as wake words, display name, location mode, notification forwarding policies, and various gated preferences related to gateway tokens, passwords, and other device configurations.

classes.name: SecurePrefs
classes.description: Main class providing secure and regular preferences handling with various device and app-specific settings, including encryption and management of notification policies and gateway credentials.

methods.name: loadGatewayToken
methods.description: Retrieves the stored gateway token, checking the override value, internal cache, and persistent secure preferences.

methods.name: saveGatewayToken
methods.description: Stores the gateway token securely with an associated key.

methods.name: loadGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Retrieves the bootstrap token, utilizing internal cache and persistent secure preferences.

methods.name: loadGatewayPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the gateway password from secure preferences.

methods.name: getNotificationForwardingPolicy
methods.description: Builds and returns the notification forwarding policy based on current preferences and mode.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingMode
methods.description: Sets the notification forwarding mode (allowlist or blocklist).

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingPackages
methods.description: Sets the list of notification packages to forward.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingQuietHours
methods.description: Enables/disables quiet hours and sets start/end times for notification suppression.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingMaxEventsPerMinute
methods.description: Configures the maximum number of notification forwarding events per minute.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingSessionKey
methods.description: Sets the session key used in notification forwarding policy.

methods.name: setLastDiscoveredStableId
methods.description: Stores the last discovered stable ID.

methods.name: setLocationMode
methods.description: Sets the location mode (e.g., off, always).

methods.name: setManualEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables manual gateway configuration.

methods.name: setManualTls
methods.description: Enables or disables TLS for manual gateway.

methods.name: setCanvasDebugStatusEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables canvas debug status.
